response.justification: This candidate is an accomplished software engineer with 20 years of experience and demonstrated seniority, but the role requires specialized expertise in hardware design, SoC/IP modeling, and AI accelerator optimization—domains completely absent from this resume. The candidate's entire career focuses on software development across web, backend, and embedded systems, with no evidence of chip design, GPU architecture knowledge, or deep learning workload optimization. While recent work on AI-agent infrastructure shows exposure to AI, this is software-focused orchestration work, not hardware performance optimization. The fundamental domain mismatch makes this an unsuitable fit regardless of general seniority level.
strengths: 20 years of proven seniority and performance optimization experience across complex systems handling high throughput and low-latency requirements
Recent exposure to AI infrastructure and demonstrated ability to learn emerging technical domains quickly at re:cinq
Strong software craftsmanship fundamentals and experience architecting scalable systems across multiple technology stacks
concerns: Zero experience with SoC design, IP modeling, or any hardware-level optimization—the core technical requirement of this role
No background in GPU architecture, AI accelerators, or deep neural network training/inference optimization despite recent AI-adjacent work
Career trajectory is entirely in software development; lacks the specialized hardware engineering domain expertise required at principal level for infrastructure roles

key_factors.factor: Hardware design and SoC/IP modeling expertise
AI accelerator and deep learning workload optimization background
Years of experience and seniority level
